entries.title: I John 4:1
segments: ¶Beloved, believe not every spirit, but prove the spirits, if they are of God; because many false prophets are gone out into the world.

entries.title: I John 4:2
segments: Hereby ye know the Spirit of God: every spirit which confesses Jesus Christ come in flesh is of God;

entries.title: I John 4:3
segments: and every spirit which does not confess Jesus Christ come in flesh is not of God: and this is that [power] of the antichrist, [of] which ye have heard that it comes, and now it is already in the world.

entries.title: I John 4:4
segments: ¶*Ye* are of God, children, and have overcome them, because greater is he that [is] in you than he that [is] in the world.

entries.title: I John 4:5
segments: *They* are of the world; for this reason they speak [as] of the world, and the world hears them.

entries.title: I John 4:6
segments: *We* are of God; he that knows God hears us; he who is not of God does not hear us. From this we know the spirit of truth and the spirit of error.

entries.title: I John 4:7
segments: ¶Beloved, let us love one another; because love is of God, and every one that loves has been begotten of God, and knows God.

entries.title: I John 4:8
segments: He that loves not has not known God; for God is love.

entries.title: I John 4:9
segments: Herein as to us has been manifested the love of God, that God has sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.

entries.title: I John 4:10
segments: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son a propitiation for our sins.

entries.title: I John 4:11
segments: Beloved, if God has so loved us, we also ought to love one another.

entries.title: I John 4:12
segments: No one has seen God at any time: if we love one another, God abides in us, and his love is perfected in us.

entries.title: I John 4:13
segments: Hereby we know that we abide in him and he in us, that he has given to us of his Spirit.

entries.title: I John 4:14
segments: ¶And *we* have seen, and testify, that the Father has sent the Son [as] Saviour of the world.

entries.title: I John 4:15
segments: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God abides in him, and he in God.

entries.title: I John 4:16
segments: And *we* have known and have believed the love which God has to us. God is love, and he that abides in love abides in God, and God in him.

entries.title: I John 4:17
segments: ¶Herein has love been perfected with us that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, that even as *he* is, *we* also are in this world.

entries.title: I John 4:18
segments: There is no fear in love, but perfect love casts out fear; for fear has torment, and he that fears has not been made perfect in love.

entries.title: I John 4:19
segments: *We* love because *he* has first loved us.

entries.title: I John 4:20
segments: If any one say, I love God, and hate his brother, he is a liar: for he that loves not his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?

entries.title: I John 4:21
segments: And this commandment have we from him, That he that loves God love also his brother.
